quests.name: Trouble with Zombies
quests.summary: The banker wants the zombie near Narustead thinned out.
intro: The zombie beyond the walls grow bolder every week. Customers will not walk the road.
Put down 11 of them close to Narustead and I will make it worth your while.
outro: The road is quieter already. Here, as promised.

quests.name: Short on Raw Tuna
quests.summary: The general store keeper of Narustead has run out of raw tuna.
intro: My stores are bare. I need 18 raw tuna and nobody in Narustead has any to spare.
Bring them to me, however you come by them.
outro: That will keep me going for a good while. Take this for your trouble.

quests.name: A Parcel for the Realtor
quests.summary: Carry a parcel across Narustead to the realtor.
intro: This should have gone to the realtor days ago and I cannot leave my post.
Take it over for me and come back when it is done.
outro: Delivered and settled? Good. Here is something for the legwork.

lines: player: A delivery from the barber.
At last. I had begun to think it lost. Tell them the account is settled.

quests.name: Word to the Armour Shop Keeper
quests.summary: Call on the armour shop keeper of Narustead and bring back their answer.
intro: I need an answer from the armour shop keeper and I would rather not shout it across the street.
Call on them as a customer, then ask how our accounts stand.
outro: Balanced? Then I can sleep tonight. My thanks.

lines: player: The sword shop keeper sent me to ask after the ledgers.
Tell them the figures balance, for once. There is nothing owed between us this season.

quests.name: Eyes on the Narustead Sewers
quests.summary: Climb down into Narustead Sewers and report what you see.
intro: Something has been scratching under the streets at night. It comes from Narustead Sewers.
Go down the entrance, take a look around and come back in one piece.
outro: So it is as bad as I feared. Thank you for looking, that took nerve.

quests.name: A Parcel for the Clothes Shop Keeper

Take it over for me and come back when it is done.
outro: Delivered and settled? Good. Here is something for the legwork.

lines: player: A delivery from the food shop keeper.
At last. I had begun to think it lost. Tell them the account is settled.

quests.name: Sweeping the Narustead Sewers
quests.summary: Clear giant rat out of Narustead Sewers and tell the barber.
intro: Narustead Sewers is crawling with giant rat, and they come up through the drains.
Go down, kill 18 of them, then let the barber know their cellar is safe.
outro: Both done? Narustead owes you more than I can pay, but take this.

lines: player: Narustead Sewers is clearer than it was. 18 giant rat fewer.
Then the cellars on this street are safe a while longer. I will tell the others.

quests.name: Supply Run to Renudale
quests.summary: Gather coal for the general store keeper, then carry a shipment to Renudale.
intro: I have an order from Renudale and nothing to fill it with.
Bring me 22 coal, then take the packed shipment to the general store keeper there and do some business while you are in town.
outro: They took the lot? Then we have a trade route. Your share, as agreed.

lines: player: Goods from the general store keeper in Narustead.
From Narustead? Then the roads are open after all. Set it down there.

quests.name: The Long Hunt
quests.summary: Hunt the creatures around Narustead and bring back coal.
intro: The wilds around Narustead need a firm hand. Start with 11 zombie outside the walls, then 18 giant spider down in Narustead Sewers.
When that is done, bring me 22 coal to show for it.
outro: A proper hunt. The town will eat and sleep easier for it.

quests.name: Votes for the Council
quests.summary: Gather support around Narustead for the sword shop keeper.
intro: The council meets soon and I am short of friends.
Speak to the realtor, carry whatever they give you, and see that the paperwork is lodged.
outro: Agreed, all of them? You have a talent for this. Here.

lines: player: The sword shop keeper asks whether you will stand with them at the next council.
I will, if the magic shop keeper does. Take this sealed note over and we shall see.
player: A sealed note, from the realtor.
Hm. They want my vote. Very well, tell your employer it is agreed.

quests.name: The Fall of the Fallen Warden
quests.summary: March on Ashen Redoubt, break its creatures and bring down The Fallen Warden.
intro: Ashen Redoubt has stood against Narustead for too long. The Fallen Warden sits at the bottom of it.
Learn what you can from the barber, fight your way through 26 ghost and end The Fallen Warden.
Bring 11 steel bar back so the town can rebuild.
outro: It is done, then. They will sing about this in every tavern from here to the coast.
Take your reward. You have more than earned it.

lines: player: What do you know of Ashen Redoubt?
Only that those who go in come back thin and quiet. The Fallen Warden rules it now.
player: Word from Narustead: The Fallen Warden is dead.
Dead? Then the caravans can leave at dawn. This news is worth more than gold.

quests.name: The Narustead Trade Route
quests.summary: Open a trade route between Narustead and Renudale.
intro: I mean to open a trade route to Renudale. It needs a contract carried, a road made safe and a courier who is proven underground.
Deliver the contract, trade there, cut down 26 spider near our walls and prove yourself in the dungeoneering caves.
Then have the banker underwrite the venture.
outro: Signed, safe and funded. You have changed the fortunes of this town.
Here is your cut of the first season.

lines: player: A contract from the sword shop keeper in Narustead.
A fair offer. But the road between us is not safe, and you know it.
player: The route to Renudale is open and the contract is signed.
Then I will underwrite it. Narustead has not had news this good in years.

quests.name: The Thing Beneath Narustead
quests.summary: Find what rules Narustead Sewers, weaken its nest and destroy The Rat King.
intro: Something rules Narustead Sewers and it is getting stronger. I want it gone.
Ask the realtor what they have heard, see it for yourself, then come back and we will decide how to break the nest.
When it is weak, kill it and tell the banker.
outro: I felt the ground go still. Narustead is yours to walk freely, friend.
Take this. It is everything I promised and a little more.

lines: player: Have you heard anything from below the streets?
Every night. Something large is down there, and the small ones answer to it. They call it The Rat King.
So you have seen it. We can thin them by force, or I can have the guard hold the drains if they are supplied.
steps.prompt: How will you weaken the nest?

options.text: I will cut them down myself.
Supply the guard and let them hold the drains.

lines: player: The Rat King is dead. Narustead Sewers is quiet.
Then the vaults are safe and so is everyone above them. The town will hear of this.
